title: The unique 1-critical graph is $K_1$
statement: Let $G$ be a finite graph on a nonempty vertex set. Then $G$ is $1$-critical if and only if $G$ is isomorphic to $K_1$, the complete graph on a single vertex.
replaced:
First case (B\&M \S{}8.1, verbatim). \emph{Show that the only 1-critical graph is
\texttt{K$_{1}$} \dots{}}
